sharedworlds.button.open.tooltip: Share a world, or add one someone else shared
sharedworlds.screen.title: Shared Worlds
sharedworlds.share.none_selected: Select one of your worlds to share it, or add one someone else shared.
sharedworlds.share.unavailable: "%s" can't be shared right now (it's open elsewhere or from another version).
sharedworlds.pick.share: Choose where to put the shared copy
sharedworlds.share.confirm.title: Share "%s"?
sharedworlds.share.confirm.message:
It will be copied to:
%s

Everyone who plays it needs to be able to reach that folder. Your own copy stays in your worlds.
sharedworlds.share.done.title: World shared
sharedworlds.share.done.message:
"%s" is now shared. Other players can add it with "Add from a shared folder", choosing this folder:
%s
sharedworlds.add.confirm.title: Add a shared world?
sharedworlds.add.confirm.copy:
Copy the shared world in
%s

into your worlds as "%s"?
sharedworlds.add.confirm.link:
You already have this world as "%s". Link it to the shared copy in
%s?

The next time you open it, it's checked against the shared copy and updated if needed (your copy is backed up first).
sharedworlds.add.done.title: World added
sharedworlds.add.done.message: "%s" is in your worlds. Open it as usual: it updates from the shared copy each time.
sharedworlds.error.unexpected: Something went wrong (%s). See the log for details.
sharedworlds.delete.warning:
Only your copy of "%s" will be deleted. The shared copy in
%s
isn't touched, and you can add it again from Shared Worlds.
sharedworlds.locked.title: "%s" is being hosted
sharedworlds.locked.holder:
%s opened it at %s.
Join their game to play, or open it here once they've quit.
sharedworlds.locked.unknown: Someone else has it open, but their lock file couldn't be read.
sharedworlds.locked.stale:
If nobody is actually playing it (for example after a crash), delete %s from the shared folder:
%s
